sentences.en: In the coffee house they asked a question.

sentences.ar: הם שאלו: מה הדבר הכי מתוק?
sentences.en: They asked: what is the sweetest thing?
One said: honey from the village.
Another said: dates from the tree.
One said: sugar from the city.
Everyone agreed that it is true.
Juha sat and did not say anything.

sentences.ar: הם שאלו אותו: ומה אתה אומר?
sentences.en: They asked him: and what do you say?
Juha said: everyone here is wrong.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: הדבר הכי מתוק הוא שינה.
sentences.en: He said: the sweetest thing is sleep.

sentences.ar: הם אמרו: אין לה טעם בכלל.
sentences.en: They said: it has no taste at all.
He said: think about the morning.
He said: you are very tired.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: אני אשים דבש לידכם.
sentences.en: He said: I shall put honey beside you.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: ואשים גם עוד חצי שעה.
sentences.en: He said: and I shall also put another half hour.
He asked: which of the two will you choose?
